name: link-preview
title: Link Preview
description: A word inside body copy opens a rounded card showing a screenshot of the page it points to. The card springs up above the link and drifts sideways as the pointer moves.
use: Body copy contains links and a screenshot would help readers decide whether to click.
avoid: Live screenshots depend on an external API per URL, and the preview is only wired to hover.
a11y: The preview pops with a spring and no reduced-motion check; both images use generic alt text. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white rounded card floats above an underlined link, holding a small screenshot of the linked page with a thin light border and soft shadow. It sits over a dark stage with a bold sentence beneath.
behaves: Hovering a link for a moment pops the preview up from below with a spring, and it slides slightly sideways as the pointer crosses the word. It closes after a short delay when the pointer leaves.
customise: Pass the target url, the visible label as children, and a width and height; use isStatic with your own imageSrc or leave it to the live screenshot service. Styling comes through className.
weight: light: A small hover card with one image and a spring slide.
